messages:
Maria: Nightshift liftwatch check — kicking off preflight for the bridge rollout. Canary slice s0 -> 3% at 00:45 PT. Quick format: what I did / blockers / plan.
Sam: ✅ Observability stack looks green. Dashboards to watch: /dash/bridge-latency, /dash/error-rate, /dash/kv-cache. Ran a 10r/s smoke, CPU & GPU telemetry nominal.
Pranav: Runtime side: applied mem-leak patch and quantized profile to canary image. KV cache warm + prefix cache prepopulated (top 500). No regressions in local soak.
Jen: Product here — feature flag target: ff_bridge_v2. Plan: enable only on canary slice, monitor beta cohort flows (login -> generate -> save). Notify partners if stable.
Liam: Oncall for 00:45-02:45 PT. I'll own SLO paging. Thresholds: p95 > 450ms or errors > 0.8% -> page.
Maria: Flip command (will run at 00:45): `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/v1/ff_bridge_v2 -d '{"enable":true,"scope":"slice:s0"}'` — tagging the action in audit logs.
Sam: Rollback plan if needed: 1) disable FF 2) route traffic to fallback model variant 3) revert runtime commit `cf3a9`. I'll be on standby for immediate changes.
Pranav: Heads up — set `max_inflight=50` for canary pods to avoid queueing against backend throttles. Memory headroom ~18GB/GPU after patch.
deploy-bot: Canary started — slice s0 -> 3% at 00:46:12 UTC (deploy id c-20240318-01).
Maria: Add tag `liftwatch=nightshift` to traces if you see anomalies so we can filter quickly.
Jen: Smoke checklist for observers: login, prompt roundtrip, save state. Ping me w/ failure repros + user id. @Maria @Sam
Liam: Will escalate after 3 consecutive error bursts or 5m sustained p95 breach. I'll also keep an eye on paging noise.
Sam: Observability note — if backend throttles kick in you may see queued requests; this is why `max_inflight` matters. Applying `canary-q.yaml` right after FF flip.
Pranav: Applied `canary-q.yaml` in staging; will apply to prod canary 2m post-flag flip.
Maria: Flipping flag now.
Maria: (update) Flipped. Initial telemetry: heatmap shows a short spike then settling. Links: https://app.redwood/d/bridge, flame graphs under /traces/bridge/nightwatch. :thumbsup:
Jen: LGTM from product. I'll start notifying beta partners slowly.
Sam: No alert fires yet. Continuing 10m watch.
deploy-bot: Canary health report: 5m window — p95 320ms, errors 0.12%, tokens/sec stable.
Maria: Closing thread for handoff to nightshift. If anything urgent ping #eng-oncall or DM me. Good job team. :eyes:
